description: This is an HTML web page serving as a user interface for a database visualizer application. It includes layout, styling, and JavaScript code for interacting with a backend API to list databases, tables, and fetch table data to display in tabular form.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar with clickable database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching from the backend and resetting the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the expansion or collapsing of database entries to show their tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a selected table and renders it into a table view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from fetched data to display in the UI.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell values, handling objects, long strings, and nulls with special formatting.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked, showing full data for long strings or objects.
